rows.jp: 目を覚ます。
rows.en: I woke up.

ghs.en: I am awake.

rows.jp: 陽光が窓を貫いていた。
rows.en: Sunlight speared through the window.

ghs.en: Sunlight was piercing through the window.

rows.jp: 熟睡していたらしい。夢一つ見なかった。
rows.en: Apparently I'd slept like a log. Not a single dream.

ghs.en: Seems I have been hard asleep. I did not have any dreams.

rows.jp: 時間は……７時。
rows.en: The time was... seven.

ghs.en: The time is... 7AM.

rows.jp: 学校に行く必要などない。
rows.en: There was no need to go to school.

ghs.en: There's no need to go to school or anything.

rows.jp: けど、体は動いた。
rows.en: But my body moved anyway.

ghs.en: Yet, the body moved.

rows.jp: 朝食の用意はされていない。
rows.en: No breakfast waiting for me.

ghs.en: Breakfast was not served.

rows.jp: 当然か。
rows.en: Of course not.

ghs.en: Of course.

rows.jp: 美人でキャリアな睦美おばさんは料理もうまいが、もういない。
rows.en: Aunt Mutsumi was beautiful, successful, and a fine cook too, but she was gone now.

ghs.en: Career beauty Mutsumi-obasan and her cooking so delicious are no more.

rows.jp: 引き取ってくれたこと。
rows.en: She'd taken me in.

ghs.en: She had taken custody of me,

rows.jp: 曜子ちゃんとのことを、穏便に取りはからってくれたこと……。
rows.en: She'd smoothed things over between Youko and me...

ghs.en: and she had amicably taken care of that thing with Youko-chan...

rows.jp: 感謝はいくらでもできた。
rows.en: I had no end of things to thank her for.

ghs.en: I had an indefinite amount of appreciation to give.

rows.jp: 孝行する前に、消失してしまった。
rows.en: And she'd disappeared before I could repay her kindness.

ghs.en: But before I could show filial piety, she had disappeared.

rows.jp: 机の上に、紙袋が二つ置かれていた。
rows.en: Two paper bags sat on the table.

ghs.en: On the table were laid two paper bags.

rows.jp: 中身は……サンドイッチだ。
rows.en: Inside were... sandwiches.

ghs.en: Contents... sandwiches.

rows.jp: 曜子ちゃんか。
rows.en: Youko, then.

ghs.en: Youko-chan then.

rows.jp: 一人分の袋と、二人分の袋。
rows.en: One bag held a single serving; the other, enough for two.

ghs.en: A bag with enough for one person, a bag with enough for two.

rows.jp: 朝食用と弁当用だ。
rows.en: Breakfast and lunch.

ghs.en: Breakfast and bento.

rows.jp: 弁当用が二人分の方。
rows.en: The double portion was for lunch.

ghs.en: The bento one is the one with enough for two.

rows.jp: こういうところは可愛いと思う。
rows.en: I found this side of her cute.

ghs.en: I think that side of her is adorable.

rows.jp: 彼女は人を口説くということに、まったく慣れていない。
rows.en: She had no idea how to woo anyone.

ghs.en: She's still no damn good at putting the moves on people.

rows.jp: 一人で全てまかなえるタイプだからだ。
rows.en: She was used to handling everything alone.

ghs.en: She's the type that can cover all the bases alone, that's why.

rows.jp: 十年来の知り合いである俺に対しても、ぎこちない。
rows.en: Even around me, after ten years, she was still awkward.

ghs.en: She's awkward even with me, her acquaintance of over ten years.

rows.jp: 頑張れば、もっと完璧なものになれるのにねぇ。
rows.en: If she tried a little harder, she could be even more perfect.

ghs.en: But if she works hard, she will become so much more perfect.

rows.jp: 「……いただきます」
rows.en: “...Thanks for the food.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...thank you for the food."

rows.jp: それでも。
rows.en: Even so.

ghs.en: And still,

rows.jp: 東の家に、手を合わせた。
rows.en: I pressed my palms together, facing the house to the east.

ghs.en: I joined my hands together towards that house in the East.
